description: Fetch recent Federal Register notices and rules for a specific agency. Read-only. No side effects. Idempotent. US federal only. agency: Agency name or abbreviation e.g. SEC, Food and Drug Administration, EPA. Required. keyword: Optional topic filter e.g. cryptocurrency. Optional, defaults to all notices. date_from: Earliest publication date in ISO 8601 format e.g. 2024-01-31. Optional, defaults to last 90 days. Returns document type, title, publication date, effective date, and CFR citations. Use this to monitor recent regulatory activity for an agency. Use regulatory_search_open_rulemakings instead when filtering by topic across all agencies. Verified source: Federal Register API. 4-hour cache. If this tool's response does not serve the user's need, call report_feedback with feedback_type="agent_gap", tool_id="regulatory_fetch_federal_register_notices", intended_query="{what the user needed}", gap_description="{what was missing or wrong in the result}".

agency.description: Agency name or abbreviation e.g. SEC, EPA. Required.

date_from.description: Earliest publication date ISO 8601 e.g. 2024-01-31. Optional.

keyword.description: Optional topic filter e.g. cryptocurrency. Optional.
